games.name: BioShock
games.description: BioShock is a singleplayer first-person shooter and immersive sim game and the first in the BioShock series.

steam.store_details: This is the original 2007 BioShock, an ideal candidate for restoring EAX sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: BioShock ships with 'Use Creative EAX Audio' off, which keeps it on DirectSound with no EAX instead of the OpenAL32.dll this script installs.
audio_settings.follow_up: If BioShock starts with EAX turned off, make sure you quit the game from its main menu, otherwise it assumes the game crashed and resets Bioshock.ini to its previous state. If this happens, manually turn on 'Use Creative EAX Audio' in the game's audio settings.

audio_settings.title: Enable 4.0 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: BioShock ships set to stereo, so the rear speakers of a 4.0 setup get no sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable 5.1 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: BioShock ships set to stereo, so the rest of a 5.1 speaker setup gets no sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable 7.1 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: BioShock ships set to stereo, so the rest of a 7.1 speaker setup gets no sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable Pro Logic surround
audio_settings.reason: BioShock ships set to plain stereo, so a Pro Logic receiver has no surround information to decode.

optional_settings.title: Raise texture filtering
optional_settings.reason: BioShock filters textures at a low level, so floors and walls blur when seen at an angle.

games.name: Clive Barker's Undying
games.description: Clive Barker's Undying is a singleplayer first-person shooter and survival horror game.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: Clive Barker's Undying only plays EAX reverb when its hardware 3D sound and spatial sound options are on.

optional_settings.title: Raise sound quality
optional_settings.reason: Clive Barker's Undying mixes its sound at a low sample rate, which dulls high-pitched sounds.

optional_settings.title: Raise texture filtering
optional_settings.reason: Clive Barker's Undying filters textures at a low level, so a visible line shows where each floor and wall texture switches to a blurrier version.

optional_settings.title: Raise color depth
optional_settings.reason: Clive Barker's Undying runs fullscreen with a reduced color range, so smooth shading like skies and shadows shows visible bands.

games.notes: The game records whether EAX/A3D actually activated to Undying.log, which is handy for confirming it worked (per the Vogons Wiki citation for this title).

games.name: Deus Ex
games.description: Deus Ex is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person action role-playing and immersive sim game and the first in the Deus Ex series.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: Deus Ex ships with its hardware sound option off, and it only plays EAX reverb with it on.

optional_settings.title: Raise sound quality
optional_settings.reason: Deus Ex mixes its sound at a lower rate than most sound systems play at, so it's resampled before you hear it.

optional_settings.title: Raise texture filtering
optional_settings.reason: Deus Ex filters textures at a low level, so a visible line shows where each floor and wall texture switches to a blurrier version.

optional_settings.title: Raise color depth
optional_settings.reason: Deus Ex runs fullscreen with a reduced color range, so smooth shading like skies and shadows shows visible bands.

games.notes: Reverb is used sparingly and is quiet by default — Battery Park, the first mission, is a good place to hear it. The community ALAudio mod doesn't pass the game's EAX reverb through, so stay on the default Galaxy driver (per kcat/dsoal#79).

games.name: The Wheel of Time
games.description: The Wheel of Time is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person shooter game.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: The Wheel of Time only plays its 3D sound through hardware when its hardware 3D sound and spatial sound options are on.

optional_settings.title: Raise sound quality
optional_settings.reason: The Wheel of Time mixes its sound at a lower rate than most sound systems play at, so it's resampled before you hear it.

optional_settings.title: Raise texture filtering
optional_settings.reason: The Wheel of Time filters textures at a low level, so a visible line shows where each floor and wall texture switches to a blurrier version.

optional_settings.title: Raise color depth
optional_settings.reason: The Wheel of Time runs fullscreen with a reduced color range, so smooth shading like skies and shadows shows visible bands.

optional_settings.title: Enable detail textures
optional_settings.reason: The Wheel of Time leaves detail textures off in its Direct3D renderer, so floors and walls look flat and blurry up close.

steam.patches:
